'
EXPECTED = {'aninexus_bridge.py': '3b86148b40bba1fb43e0a76594269d95f7a88a9000a2549d784f39f884dc1499', 'aninexus_webapp_ui.py': '8b5fb1f069a62771e5c894846f855724e2162e9278ca48d11745b0fe1c001eb1', 'tests/test_aninexus_webapp_ui.py': 'daef1c93ba39ad1ab2feb04653ea1ed1fdb44c90f285fc5b92300586f5fdc12f', '.env.example': 'a31930098a77dec2318a47a3e7fba04d308418e3e11dfa251177501c8ceb2466', 'commands/anime.py': '0b3192978146c18bfe91c5f1acac2ab377b28c99ed662c0efbf3a363ee0f9a64', 'commands/cards.py': 'b63137b2d6a72c4ecb7ab50867e9fc95f9f66fe79f4e492f080672d871fe459d', 'commands/cards_admin.py': 'cdeec0da848be8945a1ab5a3b6b1d732867bb03f214ce54a3eedcd4ba00faa31', 'commands/manga.py': '85b883501156569b7c5231244055f03d29f4df766959d7f37fb3ec7c4bd4b55a', 'utils/runtime_guard.py': '9ac8e3d95f0286767efd4df0205a08f36a9f4882435154c356f885d0a3d30ce0', 'webapp.py': '058605bf1b20d1c1bc07e8a6fdc885d038a300dd16a51fc6b1ac6068e91fb63d'}
TEMPORARY_PATHS = (
    ".github/workflows/export-main-once.yml",
    ".github/workflows/apply-aninexus-repair.yml",
    "scripts/apply_aninexus_repair.py",
)

def safe_target(name: str) -> Path:
    target = (ROOT / name).resolve()
    if target != ROOT and ROOT not in target.parents:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unsafe path: {name}")
    return target

def main() -> None:
    patch_path = ROOT / ".aninexus-repair.patch"
    patch_path.write_bytes(lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(PATCH_B64)))
    subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--check", str(patch_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "apply", "--whitespace=nowarn", str(patch_path)], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
    patch_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    archive = lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(ARCHIVE_B64))
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:") as handle:
        for member in handle.getmembers():
            if not member.isfile():
                continue
            target = safe_target(member.name)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = handle.extractfile(member)
            if source is None:
                raise RuntimeError(f"missing member: {member.name}")
            target.write_bytes(source.read())

    for relative, expected in EXPECTED.items():
        digest = hashlib.sha256(safe_target(relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        if digest != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"checksum mismatch for {relative}")

    for relative in TEMPORARY_PATHS:
        safe_target(relative).unlink(missing_ok=True)

    print(f"Applied {len(EXPECTED)} AniNexus repair files.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
